# Effects

Effects are lines that do something. 105 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## Add {#add}

```carve
add %object% to %variable%
```

Adds to a number variable, or appends to a list (`add "x" and "y" to {list::*}`).

```carve
add 1 to {joins::%uuid of player%}
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Add or remove items {#inventory_items}

```carve
add %item% to %player%'s inventory
remove %item% from %player%['s inventory]
```

Adds items to, or takes up to that many items from, a player's inventory.

```carve
remove 2 diamonds from player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Apply potion effect {#apply_potion}

```carve
apply [potion of] <effect> [[of tier] %number%] to %player% [for %timespan%]
```

Gives a potion effect. The number is the tier (default 1); the time defaults to 15 seconds.

```carve
apply potion of speed 2 to player for 10 seconds
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Ban {#ban}

```carve
ban ip %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
ban %object% by ip [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
ban %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
```

Bans a player or name, or their IP, with an optional reason.

```carve
ban "Alex" because of "cheating"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Break block {#break_block}

```carve
(break|destroy) %block%
```

Breaks a block and updates its neighbours. No drops.

```carve
break targeted block of player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [blocks](../syntax/blocks.md)

## Broadcast {#broadcast}

```carve
broadcast %text%
```

Sends a message to every online player.

```carve
broadcast "&e%player% joined!"
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Burn time {#burn_time}

```carve
(burn|burning|fire) (duration|time)
```

Sets how long an entity stays on fire, used as `set burn time of player to 5 seconds`.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Cancel event {#cancel}

```carve
cancel [the] event
```

Stops the event. Works before the first `wait`. Some events cannot be cancelled; using it there is a load error.

```carve
on chat:
    cancel event
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Change experience {#xp}

```carve
set (xp|exp|experience|total experience) of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s (xp|exp|experience|total experience) to %number%
add %number% to (xp|exp|experience|total experience) of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s (xp|exp|experience|total experience)
add %number% (xp|exp|experience) [points] to %player%
remove %number% from (xp|exp|experience|total experience) of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s (xp|exp|experience|total experience)
remove %number% (xp|exp|experience) [points] from %player%
give %number% (xp|exp|experience) [points] to %player%
give %player% %number% (xp|exp|experience) [points]
```

Changes total experience points. Never below 0.

```carve
give player 10 xp
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [xp-level](../syntax/xp-level.md)

## Change food level {#food}

```carve
set (food level|hunger) of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s (food level|hunger) to %number%
add %number% to (food level|hunger) of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s (food level|hunger)
remove %number% from (food level|hunger) of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s (food level|hunger)
```

Changes the food level, 0 to 20.


Since **unreleased** · Guide: [health-food](../syntax/health-food.md)

## Change health {#health}

```carve
set health of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s health to %number%
add %number% to health of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s health
remove %number% from health of %player%
remove %number% from %player%'s health
```

Sets, raises or lowers health (20 = 10 hearts). Values are kept between 0 and max health; 0 kills.

```carve
set health of player to 10
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [health-food](../syntax/health-food.md)

## Create explosion {#explosion}

```carve

```

## Create, load or unload a world {#create_world}

```carve
create [a] [new] world [named] %text% [with environment (normal|nether|end)]
load world %text%
unload world %text%
create [a] [new] world [named] %text%
create [a] [new] world [named] %text% with environment (normal|overworld)
create [a] [new] world [named] %text% with environment nether
create [a] [new] world [named] %text% with environment end
load world [named] %text%
unload world [named] %text%
```

Creates a world (or loads it when it exists) or unloads one. Names are letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`. A refusal from the server is a script error with the reason.

```carve
on join:
    create world "arena" with environment nether
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w4-skbee-raytrace-world](../syntax/w4-skbee-raytrace-world.md)

## Filter section {#w4_filter}

```carve

```

Keeps the elements of a list for which every condition below holds. `input` is the element and `input index` its index.

```carve

filter {_l::*} to match:
    input > 2
```

## If / else {#if}

```carve
if %condition%:
else if %condition%:
else:
```

Runs the indented block when the condition is true. A condition on its own line stops the trigger when false.

```carve
if {coins::%uuid of player%} >= 10:
    send "rich" to player
else:
    send "poor" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)


## Send component {#send_component}

```carve
send [text] (component|components) %text% [to %player%]
broadcast [text] (component|components) %text%
send action bar [text] (component|components) %text% to %player%
```

Sends a text component (with hover and click parts) to players or the whole server.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Send message {#send}

```carve
send %text% [to %player%]
```

Sends a message. Without `to` it goes to whoever started the trigger. `to console` writes to the server log. Color codes work.

```carve
send "&aHello %player%!" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Send resource pack {#resource_pack}

```carve
send [the] resource pack %text% [with hash %text%] to %player%
```

Asks a player to download a resource pack, optionally checked against a SHA-1 hash.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Send title {#title}

```carve
send title %text% [with subtitle %text%] to %player%
```

Shows a big title, with an optional subtitle, on the player's screen.

```carve
send title "Welcome" with subtitle "to the server" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Set {#set}

```carve
set %variable% to %object%
```

Stores a value in a variable. `set {list::*} to a, b and c` replaces a whole list.

```carve
set {spawn} to location of player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Set block {#set_block}

```carve
set %block% to %item%
```

Places a block of that type. Any block form works on the left.

```carve
set block below player to diamond block
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [blocks](../syntax/blocks.md)

## Set gamemode {#gamemode}

```carve
set gamemode of %player% to %text% [mode]
set game mode of %player% to %text% [mode]
set %player%'s gamemode to %text% [mode]
set %player%'s game mode to %text% [mode]
```

Changes the game mode. The mode can be a word, text, a number 0 to 3 or a short form (`s`, `c`, `a`, `sp`).

```carve
set gamemode of player to creative
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [gamemode](../syntax/gamemode.md)

## Set metadata {#set_metadata}

```carve
set metadata value %text% of %object% to %object%
```

Stores a metadata value on an entity or block. Metadata is lost on restart.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Set persistent data {#set_persistent_data}

```carve
set persistent data value %text% of %object% to %object%
```

Stores a value on an entity, block or item that survives restarts.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Set slot {#set_slot}

```carve
set slot %number% of %inventory% to %item%
```

Puts an item in a slot (counted from 0). `air` empties it. `player's current inventory` is the open Carve menu.

```carve
set slot 4 of player's current inventory to diamond
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Sort list {#sort}

```carve
sort %list% [in descending order]
```

Sorts a list in place. Numbers sort by value, before text.

```carve
set {_n::*} to 3, 1 and 2
sort {_n::*}
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [list-ops](../syntax/list-ops.md)

## Spawn section {#w4_spawn_section}

```carve
spawn %entity% [at %location%]:
```

Spawns an entity and runs the body; `event-entity` is the new entity.

```carve
spawn a zombie at player:
    set name of event-entity to "Bob"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w4-functions-sections](../syntax/w4-functions-sections.md)

## Sprint {#sprint}

```carve
make %player% sprint
make %player% start sprinting
make %player% stop sprinting
```

Makes a player start or stop sprinting.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Stop {#stop}

```carve
stop
```

Ends the whole trigger, or a function that returns nothing.

```carve
if player does not have permission "vip":
    stop
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [loops](../syntax/loops.md)

## Stop server {#stop_server}

```carve
stop [the] server
shut down [the] server
shutdown [the] server
```

Shuts the server down.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Stop sound {#stop_sound}

```carve
stop all sounds [(for|from) %player%]
stop [the] (sound|sounds) %text% [(for|from) %player%]
```

Stops one sound or all sounds for a player.

```carve
stop all sounds for player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [sounds](../syntax/sounds.md)

## Strike lightning {#lightning}

```carve
strike lightning [effect] at %location%
show [a] lightning effect at %location%
```

Strikes a real bolt. With `effect` it is only the flash and sound.

```carve
strike lightning effect at player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Suppress warnings {#suppress_warnings}

```carve
[locally] suppress (conflict|conjunction|missing conjunction|variable save|variable saved|deprecation|deprecated syntax|unreachable code|empty script) (warning|warnings)
```

Turns off a kind of compiler warning for the script, or for the next lines with `locally`.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Swing hand {#swing_hand}

```carve
make %player% swing
make %player% swing [their] [main] hand
make %player% swing [their] off hand
```

Plays the hand swing animation of a player.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Tab list name {#tab_list_name}

```carve
set tab list name of %object% to %text%
set %object%'s tab list name to %text%
reset tab list name of %object%
reset %object%'s tab list name
set %player%'s (player|tab) list name to %text%
set (player|tab) list name of %player% to %text%
(reset|clear) %player%'s (player|tab) list name
(reset|clear) (player|tab) list name of %player%
```

Sets or resets the name shown in the tab list.

```carve
set tab list name of player to "&a[VIP] %player%"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Tab list priority {#tab_list_priority}

```carve
set %player%'s (player|tab) list priority to %number%
set (player|tab) list priority of %player% to %number%
```

Sets where a player is sorted in the tab list.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Teleport {#teleport}

```carve
teleport %player% to %number%, %number%, %number%
```

Teleports the player to coordinates in their current world.

```carve
teleport player to 0, 64, 0
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Teleport to location {#teleport_location}

```carve
teleport %player% to %location%
```

Teleports the player to a location. A location without a world keeps the player in their world.

```carve
teleport player to location(0, 64, 0, world "world")
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Toggle {#toggle}

```carve
(toggle|switch) %variable%
```

Flips a boolean variable between true and false.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Unban {#unban}

```carve
(unban|pardon) ip %object%
(unban|pardon) %object%
```

Lifts a ban or an IP ban.

```carve
unban "Alex"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Wait {#wait}

```carve
wait %number% (tick|ticks)
wait %number% (second|seconds)
wait %timespan%
```

Pauses the run without blocking the server. A timespan is rounded to the nearest tick.

```carve
wait 5 seconds
send "5 seconds later" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [timespans](../syntax/timespans.md)

## While loop {#while}

```carve
while %condition%:
```

Runs the block while the condition holds. Checked before every round.

```carve
set {_i} to 0
while {_i} < 5:
    add 1 to {_i}
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [loops](../syntax/loops.md)
